shape: Dead-end with multi-sub-area floor (single south gate)
description: Single-portal dead-end room with a wider interior than paru-A na1. After the south entry hub there's a north row (yffftp + q1cgjr + y7dg72) and a south-center row (llhhye + w0rduz + suj3p5) that interconnect. The autopilot enters and exits via the same south portal; any in-cell objective routes through the south entry hub and then to the appropriate sub-area.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-7.14, 18.91) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

traversalNotes: DEAD-END: enter and leave through spawn_south. After kill_all / objective sequence, return to south_gate.
DISPATCH RULE: south_inner is the dispatch hub. Any objective routes south_gate → south_inner → sub-area anchor → reverse.
NORTH ROW (north_west, north_center, north_east) and SOUTH ROW (south_center, center, south_east) form two interconnected combat zones — the room can stage enemies in either.
Same primitive family as paru-A na1 but with more floor area / more sub-zones.
